newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares in sluggish trade, index up.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares in sluggish trade, index up.

text.p: Shares on the Estonian stock market were sluggish on Monday but the market's index gained slightly, dealers said.
The volume on the main official list was just 4.7 million kroons and the secondary free market showed turnover of 4.4 million kroons. The Tallinn stock exchange index rose 0.16 percent to 106.4.
Savings Bank was in the spotlight again as it rose to 45.25 kroons from 44 kroons on trade of 2.3 million kroons, continuing to climb after the over-subscription last week of its issue of new shares.
But dealers cautioned that the shares may face a downturn after investors receive the new stocks on November 17.
Hansapank was also active on 1.2 million kroons but closed unchanged at 106.75 kroons.

It earlier said it was boosting the loan loss provisions at its Hansabank Latvija subsidiary, which would push the unit into a 12.46 million kroon loss for the first nine months after an earlier estimation of a 1.33 million kroon profit.
On the free market, Kalev confectionary was most active on 1.7 million kroons and closed at 595 kroons versus 565 kroons.
Builder EMV, added to the free market today, closed at 670 kroons.
